description: This file defines the 'Credit' class in the OpenCart system, specifically for handling store credit in the order total calculations, confirmation, and unconfirmation processes.

classes.name: Credit
classes.description: A class extending the core Model class to manage customer credit balances, applying credit to order totals, and handling transaction records.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total credit deduction from the order, adds it to the totals array, and adjusts the overall total.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Posts a transaction record when an order with credit is confirmed.

methods.name: unconfirm
methods.description: Removes the transaction record associated with a specific order when unconfirmed.
